> **中文** 该想起"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"的，自己浮现。跨窗口 · 跨会话 · 跨工具 —— Ambient Recall · 「潜藏追忆，如影随形」"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"🌐 Landing page · 📄 Technical reports · 🧭 Pilot Credits Program"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Promo gallery · click any thumbnail to view full size · frame-by-frame flip-through below"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Promo gallery, frame by frame (expand and flip through)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"#### Frame 3 · Welcome Tour — Every feature, explained and toggled on the spot"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why a plugin"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"In September 2026, GPT-6 Astra shipped Context Management as an experimental flagship feature: notes"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" kept across context windows, earlier history searchable, handoff preferred over compression as the "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"context windows, earlier history searchable, handoff preferred over compression as the window fills."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Seeing the announcement, we were quietly glad — like someone walking a night road alone who sees a l"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ight come on in the distance. Putting memory outside the window: structured notes, searchable archiv"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"es, handoff over compression — it turns out we are not the only traveler on this road. That a flagsh"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ip is willing to press the experimental button for it says this idea deserves to be taken seriously "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"o press the experimental button for it says this idea deserves to be taken seriously by more people."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"So we built it as an open plugin: no experimental gate, no subscription tier — install it in DSH, an"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"d every model on your machine gets its own."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| | GPT-6 Astra / Codex experimental feature | dsh-auto-memory |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Availability | Single-vendor flagship, experimental | Open plugin, any DSH model, install and go |"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"
| Notes | Keep notes across windows | Four-part handoff ledger, directly readable and editable by y"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ou |
| Archive | Earlier windows searchable | Local full archive + lexical/semantic dual-channel ret"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"rieval |
| Retrieval | history/_context tools | memory_search / memory_note gated-agent tools |
| Tr"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"igger | Token budget + handoff | Water-level awareness + pre-completion interception |
| Ownership |"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" Vendor side | All on the user's disk, governance-style writes, auditable |
| Tiers | Bound to subsc"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"ription plans | 0GB lexical → 130MB built-in semantic → 563MB Python advanced |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**One route, two arrivals: it ships with a flagship; ours walks into your machine as a plugin.**"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"*Handoff is on by default — threshold 0.75, just below the host's 0.80 auto-compaction line (see How"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" default — threshold 0.75, just below the host's 0.80 auto-compaction line (see How she hands off).*"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Why handoff isn't "write a summary" — the engineering of whiteboard and ledger"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**The problem**: asking an LLM to produce a paragraph of "what happened before" for a new window loo"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ks simple but degrades — each compaction loses a layer, and after a few rounds the handoff material "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"is out of sync with reality, **with nobody able to tell that it is**. So the rule here is: **handoff"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" material must not get to speak for itself either — it has to be traceable, decidable, and regressio"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"ust not get to speak for itself either — it has to be traceable, decidable, and regression-tested.**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Three entities, each minding one job:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Entity | What it is | Where it lives |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| **Handoff ledger** | A fixed **four-part** shape: task state / goals / approaches tried and why th"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ey failed / progress and next step | `handoff/handoff-*.md` |
| **Whiteboard** (PLAN.md) | The proje"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ct's **whole-picture map**: a human-readable planning snapshot; old versions are archived on rewrite"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" | `handoff/PLAN.md` |
| **Anchor** | Every record carries `` — **identity addressing**, not positio"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"nal addressing | inside the memory file |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Two hard engineering constraints**:
1. **Ledger quality is a hard gate, not a style suggestion.** "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"The four headings must match **verbatim** (a wrong heading breaks downstream weighted truncation and"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" the injection-side parser), each section has a minimum length, and a bad one is rejected outright —"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" the very shape of the section you're reading was formed by that gate.
2. **Anchors stop append-writ"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"es from piercing the file.** `appendAnchoredRecord()` parses the existing file first: any non-clean "},{"id":"p22s6","text":"state **fails closed** (neither appends nor rewrites); if reserved syntax appears in the body, the w"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"rite is **refused on the spot with a line number** — rather than "succeeding" and then making the wh"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ole file permanently unwritable from the next write onward."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**The kanban board is not a separate UI** — it is **another view over the same ledgers and whiteboar"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"d**: ledger entries laid out as a swimlane matrix (goals / in progress / failures and detours / arch"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"edger entries laid out as a swimlane matrix (goals / in progress / failures and detours / archived)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Memory panel · Overview (away greeting + AI period summaries)"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Welcome tour · feature switches + engine detection"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"More screenshots (click to expand)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"This overview describes the implemented plugin at **v3.2.10 / `8280500`**. Most boxes are modules in"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"side the Node host. The full interactive architecture map lives at doc"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"s/proactive-associative-memory-system-map.html; the core layering:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Memory files are plain-text Markdown; no secrets stored unless explicitly requested.
- `memory_rec"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"all` session search depends on the deployed session-query index; without it, only local search works"},{"id":"p34s3","text":".
- Advanced Python (C3) recall requires the BGE-M3 model installed in Settings → Semantic engine (~"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"563MB).
- Lexical search is a full scan without an inverted index; only matters once memories number"},{"id":"p34s5","text":" in the thousands.
- `autoConsolidateCooldownMinutes = 0` falls back to 30 (known quirk, to be addre"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"ssed).
- Plugin-set changes require a dsh restart."}],"truncated":true}
